text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho, one of the most formidable G1 events and a race of utmost importance to the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Mejiro Bright promised, she cannot let victory escape her here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please don't look so grim.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Everything will be all right. I will win, just as I said. I'll deliver the plaque to the Mejiro family with my own hands.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Bright, I trust you understand what lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Before you can properly stand in this new generation of speed-first racing, you must first display the strength to be a representative of the Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Perform well in a prestigious long-distance G1, and then win a medium-distance race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I will run just like you did on that day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I see. If you can win the spring Tenno Sho, then perhaps… Perhaps that glory that has escaped our grasp since my own race will return.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Winning will make you a fitting successor. But first, you must be able to stand at my side.
